messages.author: Alois Zdrha
messages.body:
Hi,
I wanted to perform free energy calculation on a protein complex using the
GaMD (igamd=17, see included script). All went fine for several hours and
then following exception occurred:
unsigned long long of length = 486Failed an illegal memory access was
encountered
There is no other error massage. Interestingly, only some simulation
encountered this issue while other with the same settings (just different
protein complexes) did not fail and are still being simulated. What could be
the issue? I am using amber22 and ambertools23.
Best regards,
Alois Zdrha

messages.author: ABDELATIF MESSAOUDI
messages.body:
Dear Amber users
I am trying to equilibrate my sistem. My first min trial was successful.
But my eq are giving this error "Error: an illegal memory access was
encountered launching kernel kNLSkinTest"
So do you have any idea ?
Thank you in advance
Cheers
Abdelatif Messaoudi
LCMVAR, University of Batna 1, Algeria

messages.author: Carlos Simmerling
messages.body:
Try to run it using cpus at first. It msy be from a bad initial model
(cpptraj can help check) or bad parameters) if you are using custom for
field libraries). Or perhaps bad relaxation protocol. Share more details if
any of these might be the issue.

messages.author: Anna Herz
messages.body:
Hello,
I'm running some AFE simulations using Amber22 with a hydrogen mass repartitioning factor of 3. Before the production stage, the system is previously minimised and equilibrated at each respective lambda window at 1 fs and appears to be stable.
During the production stage at 4 fs, I frequently observe the following error for some of the bound lambda windows:
"unsigned long long of length = 42Failed an illegal memory access was encountered"
I was wondering if anyone knows what this error means and what might cause it? I haven't been able to find it in any of the documentation or previous threads but I'm not sure if I've missed something.
Thank you very much!
Best wishes,
Anna

messages.author: Ryan Snyder
messages.body:
I've seen this error before when using a 4 fs timestep without the correct  hydrogen mass repartitioning. Can you check the parameter file to confirm that the masses were properly adjusted?
Ryan Snyder

Anna
